_comment: Materialised into a temp directory by test-real-project.js. Stored as a manifest rather than a project tree because the repository .gitignore blocks *.pbip / *.Report/ / *.SemanticModel/ -- a guard against Power BI Desktop injecting a licence key into a checked-in project. A manifest cannot be opened in Desktop, so no key can ever be written into it.
name: SalesVarianceDashboard

files.SalesVarianceDashboard.SemanticModel/def:
model Model
	culture: en-US
	defaultPowerBIDataSourceVersion: powerBI_V3
	sourceQueryCulture: en-US

ref table Sales
ref table Calendar
ref table Measures

relationship rel-Sales-Calendar
	fromColumn: Sales.Date
	toColumn: Calendar.Date

table Calendar

	partition Calendar = m
		mode: import
		source =
			let
				StartDate = #date(2024, 1, 1),
				EndDate = #date(2025, 12, 31),
				Dates = List.Dates(StartDate, Duration.Days(EndDate - StartDate) + 1, #duration(1, 0, 0, 0)),
				Table = Table.FromList(Dates, Splitter.SplitByNothing(), {"Date"}, null, ExtraValues.Error),
				TypedDate = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Table, {{"Date", type datetime}}),
				Year = Table.AddColumn(TypedDate, "Year", each Date.Year([Date]), Int64.Type),
				MonthNum = Table.AddColumn(Year, "Month", each Date.Month([Date]), Int64.Type),
				MonthName = Table.AddColumn(MonthNum, "Month Name", each Date.ToText([Date], "MMM"), type text),
				Quarter = Table.AddColumn(MonthName, "Quarter", each "Q" & Text.From(Date.QuarterOfYear([Date])), type text)
			in
				Quarter

	column Date
		dataType: dateTime
		isKey
		sourceColumn: Date
		summarizeBy: none

	column Year
		dataType: int64
		sourceColumn: Year
		summarizeBy: none

	column Month
		dataType: int64
		sourceColumn: Month
		summarizeBy: none

	column 'Month Name'
		dataType: string
		sourceColumn: Month Name
		sortByColumn: Month
		summarizeBy: none

	column Quarter
		dataType: string
		sourceColumn: Quarter
		summarizeBy: none

table Measures

	measure AC = SUM(Sales[Amount])
		formatString: #,##0

	measure PY =
			CALCULATE(
				[AC],
				SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR(Calendar[Date])
			)
		formatString: #,##0

	measure BU = SUM(Sales[Budget Amount])
		formatString: #,##0

table Sales

	partition Sales = m
		mode: import
		source =
			let
				Rows = Table.FromRows(
					{
						{1, "North", "Widget A", "Revenue", #date(2025,1,15), 120000, 110000},
						{2, "North", "Widget B", "Revenue", #date(2025,2,10), 85000, 90000},
						{3, "South", "Widget A", "Revenue", #date(2025,3,20), 95000, 100000},
						{4, "South", "Widget B", "Revenue", #date(2025,4,5), 72000, 75000},
						{5, "East", "Widget A", "Revenue", #date(2025,5,12), 110000, 105000},
						{6, "East", "Widget B", "Revenue", #date(2025,6,18), 64000, 68000},
						{7, "West", "Widget A", "Revenue", #date(2025,7,22), 130000, 125000},
						{8, "West", "Widget B", "Revenue", #date(2025,8,3), 78000, 80000},
						{9, "North", "Widget A", "Revenue", #date(2025,9,14), 115000, 112000},
						{10, "South", "Widget A", "Revenue", #date(2025,10,8), 98000, 95000},
						{11, "East", "Widget B", "Revenue", #date(2025,11,25), 70000, 72000},
						{12, "West", "Widget A", "Revenue", #date(2025,12,1), 140000, 135000},
						{13, "North", "Widget A", "Margin", #date(2025,1,15), 36000, 33000},
						{14, "South", "Widget A", "Margin", #date(2025,3,20), 28500, 30000},
						{15, "East", "Widget A", "Margin", #date(2025,5,12), 33000, 31500},
						{16, "West", "Widget A", "Margin", #date(2025,7,22), 39000, 37500},
						{17, "North", "Widget A", "Units", #date(2025,1,15), 1200, 1100},
						{18, "South", "Widget A", "Units", #date(2025,3,20), 950, 1000},
						{19, "East", "Widget A", "Units", #date(2025,5,12), 1100, 1050},
						{20, "West", "Widget A", "Units", #date(2025,7,22), 1300, 1250},
						{21, "North", "Widget A", "Revenue", #date(2024,1,15), 105000, 100000},
						{22, "North", "Widget B", "Revenue", #date(2024,2,10), 78000, 82000},
						{23, "South", "Widget A", "Revenue", #date(2024,3,20), 88000, 92000},
						{24, "South", "Widget B", "Revenue", #date(2024,4,5), 65000, 70000},
						{25, "East", "Widget A", "Revenue", #date(2024,5,12), 100000, 98000},
						{26, "East", "Widget B", "Revenue", #date(2024,6,18), 58000, 62000},
						{27, "West", "Widget A", "Revenue", #date(2024,7,22), 118000, 115000},
						{28, "West", "Widget B", "Revenue", #date(2024,8,3), 70000, 74000},
						{29, "North", "Widget A", "Revenue", #date(2024,9,14), 108000, 105000},
						{30, "South", "Widget A", "Revenue", #date(2024,10,8), 90000, 88000},
						{31, "East", "Widget B", "Revenue", #date(2024,11,25), 62000, 65000},
						{32, "West", "Widget A", "Revenue", #date(2024,12,1), 125000, 120000}
					},
					type table [ID = Int64.Type, Region = text, Product = text, Account = text, Date = datetime, Amount = number, #"Budget Amount" = number]
				)
			in
				Rows

	column ID
		dataType: int64
		isHidden
		sourceColumn: ID
		summarizeBy: none

	column Region
		dataType: string
		sourceColumn: Region
		summarizeBy: none

	column Product
		dataType: string
		sourceColumn: Product
		summarizeBy: none

	column Account
		dataType: string
		sourceColumn: Account
		summarizeBy: none

	column Date
		dataType: dateTime
		sourceColumn: Date
		summarizeBy: none

	column Amount
		dataType: double
		sourceColumn: Amount
		summarizeBy: sum

	column 'Budget Amount'
		dataType: double
		sourceColumn: Budget Amount
		summarizeBy: sum
